1.word_for_word: चतुर्-युक् सप्ततितमे राजसूय-क्रिया द्विजैः । — In the seventy-seventh day of the four-yuck, the Brāhmaṇas perform the Rājasūya ritual.; अग्र-पूजा-प्रसङ्गेन चैद्य-घाटदि वर्ण्यते ॥ — It is described in connection with the first worship at the Chaidya Ghat.; राजसूय-मुखे हत्वा जरासन्धं तद् अन्तरे । — In the middle of the Rājasūya sacrifice, he killed Jarāsandha.; चैद्यं तद् अन्तं कुर्वन्तं बीजं कलिम् इवावपत् ॥ — Just as the seed of Kali-yuga fell upon Śiśupāla, the son of Śiśupāla was trying to end it.; कृष्णस्य चानुभावम् इति चकारात् तस्य स्वाज्ञानुविधायित्वं चालक्ष्येत्य् अर्थः ॥१॥ — And since it is the power of Kṛṣṇa, it means that it should be observed that it is the self-knowledge of Kṛṣṇa.
1.translation: In the seventy-seventh day of the four-yuck, the Brāhmaṇas perform the Rājasūya ritual. It is described in connection with the first worship at the Chaidya Ghat. In the middle of the Rājasūya sacrifice, he killed Jarāsandha. Just as the seed of Kali-yuga fell upon Śiśupāla, the son of Śiśupāla was trying to end it. And since it is the power of Kṛṣṇa, it means that it should be observed that it is the self-knowledge of Kṛṣṇa.

2.word_for_word: तद् आह---ये स्युर् इति । — He argues that they will be.; ये त्रैलोक्यस्यापि गुरवः स्युः सनकादयः सर्वे च लोका लोक-पालाश् च ते शिरसैव तवानुशासनं वहन्ति । — Those who are the teachers of the three worlds, such as Sanaka and all the other worlds and the rulers of the worlds, carry your discipline on their heads.; दुर्लभं लब्ध्वेति । — It’s rare to find.; भाग्येनैतल् लब्धम् इति बहुमानेनेत्य् अर्थः ॥२॥ — This means that it was obtained by good fortune and by great respect.
2.translation: He argues that they will be. Those who are the teachers of the three worlds, such as Sanaka and all the other worlds and the rulers of the worlds, carry your discipline on their heads. It’s rare to find. This means that it was obtained by good fortune and by great respect.

3.word_for_word: स भवन् परमेश्वरोऽस्मकम् अनुशासनं धत्ते तद् अत्यन्त-विडम्बनम् अननुरूपम् अनुकरणम् । — That you, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is disciplining us is an extremely ridiculous and inappropriate imitation.; स्व-तेजो-हानि-प्रसङ्गाद् इत्य् अर्थः ॥३॥ — This means that he loses his own splendour.
3.translation: That you, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is disciplining us is an extremely ridiculous and inappropriate imitation. This means that he loses his own splendour.

4.word_for_word: अथवा तव पूर्णस्याज्ञापनाज्ञाधारणाभ्यां न तेजसो हानिवृद्धीअतः कृपया सर्वं सङ्गच्छत इत्याह---न ह्येकस्याद्वितीयस्येति । — Or, by commanding and holding the commands of Your perfection, there is no increase in the loss of effulgence.; समानासमानरहितस्य ब्रह्मणस्तवोभयं माया परमात्मन इति सर्वजीवनियन्तुस्तव नियम्यत्वं सुतरां नवास्तवम् अतः परानुग्रहाथैरेतैः कर्मभिस्तव तेजो न वर्धते न च ह्रसति रवेरिवोदयास्तमयादिकर्मभिरित्य् अर्थः । — You are the Supreme Soul, the Supreme Soul, who is without equality or equality. Therefore, by these actions for the benefit of others, Your effulgence does not increase or decrease, just as the sun does not increase or decrease by its activities such as rising and setting.; तथा च श्रुतिः न कर्मणा वर्धते नो कनीयान् इति ॥४॥ — Similarly, the scripture says that action does not increase our younger ones.
4.translation: Or, by commanding and holding the commands of Your perfection, there is no increase in the loss of effulgence. You are the Supreme Soul, the Supreme Soul, who is without equality or equality. Therefore, by these actions for the benefit of others, Your effulgence does not increase or decrease, just as the sun does not increase or decrease by its activities such as rising and setting. Similarly, the scripture says that action does not increase our younger ones.

5.word_for_word: नन्व् एवम् अप्य् अहं परमेश्वरो ममेदं नीचं कर्मायोग्यम् इति मनसि कथं न भवेद् अत आह---न वै त इति । — Now, even so, how can one not think that I am God and that this vile action is worthy of Me?; हे अजित, तव भक्तानाम् एव तावदियं नानाधीर् भेद-मतिर् नास्ति । — O Ajit, Your devotees alone do not have this various differences of opinion.; यथा पशूनाम् अज्ञानां वैकृता शरीर-विषया । — Just as animals are ignorant of the distortion of their bodies.; तव तु नास्तीति किं पुनर् वक्तव्यम् इत्य् अर्थः । — But what else can I say that you do not have?
5.translation: Now, even so, how can one not think that I am God and that this vile action is worthy of Me? O Ajit, Your devotees alone do not have this various differences of opinion. Just as animals are ignorant of the distortion of their bodies. But what else can I say that you do not have?

6.word_for_word: यज्ञिये यज्ञोचिते वसन्तादि-काले । — In the spring and other seasons, when the sacrifice is appropriate for the sacrifice,; युक्तान् अभियुक्तान् । — the rightful accused.; स युधिष्ठिरः ऋत्विजो होतृ-प्रमुखान् । — That Yudhisthira, the priests, were the chiefs of the Hotris.; वव्रे वृतवान् । — He asked and wrapped.
6.translation: In the spring and other seasons, when the sacrifice is appropriate for the sacrifice, the rightful accused. That Yudhisthira, the priests, were the chiefs of the Hotris. He asked and wrapped.

7.word_for_word: तान् आह---द्वैपायन इति त्रिभिः ॥७-८॥ — He called them Dvaipayanas by three.7-8
7.translation: He called them Dvaipayanas by three.7-8

9.word_for_word: अकृत-व्रणान्तान् एतान् ऋत्विग्-उपद्रष्ट्रादि-भेदेन वव्रे ॥९॥ — He chose these men who had not been wounded by the distinction of priests, observers and others.
9.translation: He chose these men who had not been wounded by the distinction of priests, observers and others.

10.word_for_word: अन्ये चोपहूता यज्ञ-दिदृक्षवस् तत्रेयुर् इत्य् अन्वयः ॥१०-११॥ — Others invited, desiring to see the sacrifice, should come there, consequently.
10.translation: Others invited, desiring to see the sacrifice, should come there, consequently.

12.word_for_word: देव-यजनं यज्ञ-भूमिम् । — The sacrifice of the gods is the land of sacrifice.; कृष्ट्वा कर्षणादिभिः संशोध्य । — plowing and repairing by traction and other means.; दीक्षयां चक्रिरे दीक्षासंस्कार-युक्तम् अकुर्वन् ॥१२॥ — They performed the initiation ceremony according to the rituals of initiation.
12.translation: The sacrifice of the gods is the land of sacrifice. plowing and repairing by traction and other means. They performed the initiation ceremony according to the rituals of initiation.

13.word_for_word: उपकरणा उपस्कराः वरुणस्य राजसूये यथा आसन्न् इति शेषः । — The remainder of the equipment and utensils are as they were in the Rājasūya of Varuṇa.; किं च, इन्द्रादयो देव-गणाः ॥१३-१४॥ — What is more, Indra and other hosts of gods.13-1
13.translation: The remainder of the equipment and utensils are as they were in the Rājasūya of Varuṇa. What is more, Indra and other hosts of gods.13-1

15.word_for_word: ये च राजादयः समाहूतास् तत्र समीयुः स्म ते सर्वे कृष्ण-भक्तस्य पाण्डु-सुतस्य राज्ञो युधिष्ठिरस्य राजसूयम् अविस्मिताः सन्तः सूपपन्नं मेनिरे इत्य् अन्वयः ॥१५॥ — And all the kings and others who were invited and assembled there were not astonished at the Rajasuya sacrifice performed by King Yudhisthira, the son of Pandu, a devotee of Krishna, and the saintly persons thought that it was a soup.
15.translation: And all the kings and others who were invited and assembled there were not astonished at the Rajasuya sacrifice performed by King Yudhisthira, the son of Pandu, a devotee of Krishna, and the saintly persons thought that it was a soup.

16.word_for_word: याजका ऋत्विजः ॥१६॥ — The priests are the priests.

17.word_for_word: सुत्ये\ऽहनि सोमाभिषवदिने ॥१७॥ — On the day of the birth of the moon.
17.translation: On the day of the birth of the moon.

18.word_for_word: अग्र्यार्हणम् अग्र-पूजा तस्यार्हं योग्यम् । — The first offering is the first worship, and it is worthy of him.; अनैकान्त्याद् योग्यानां बहुत्वेनैकस्यानिश्चयात् ॥१८-१९॥ — Because of the lack of unity of the worthy and the uncertainty of the multiplicity of the one (18-19).
18.translation: The first offering is the first worship, and it is worthy of him. Because of the lack of unity of the worthy and the uncertainty of the multiplicity of the one (18-19).

19.word_for_word: साङ्ख्यं ज्ञानं योग उपासना ॥२०॥ — Sāṅkhya is knowledge, yoga is worship.
19.translation: Sāṅkhya is knowledge, yoga is worship.

20.word_for_word: साङ्ख्यं ज्ञानम् । — Sāṅkhya is knowledge.; योग उपासना ॥२०॥ — Yoga worship.

21.word_for_word: ननु साङ्ख्यं केवलपरं योगः सविशेषणपरः कथमुभयोरेकपरत्वम्? — If Sāṅkhya is the only other, and Yoga is the other with adjectives, how can the two be one?; तत्राह---एक एवाद्वितीयो\ऽसावतः साङ्ख्यस्यैतत्परत्वं युक्तं विशेषणभूतस्य सर्वप्रपञ्चस्य तन्मयत्वात्सविशेषणविषयस्य योगस्यापि युक्तमद्वितीयपरत्वम् इत्य् आह---ऐ तदात्म्यम् इति एष श्री-कृष्ण आत्मा यस्य तदेतदात्म तस्य भावः ऐतदात्म्यम् भवितर्येव भावनिर्देशः । — There he argues that there is only one and the same\'Asavata, and since Sāṅkhya is the Supreme Being, since the whole universe, which is an adjective, is composed of it, it is also justified that Yoga, which is the subject of adjectives, is the Supreme Being.; ऐतदात्म्यम् इदं सर्वम् इति श्रुतेः । — This is the Self, this is all, according to the scriptures.; अत्र हेतुः आत्मनेति, हे सभ्याः! — The reason here is by the self, O gentlemen!; आत्माश्रयो\ऽन्यनिरपेक्षः स्वयमजः इदं जगत्सृजत्यवति हन्ति चेति ॥२१॥ — The Self-dependent, independent of others, the unborn Self, creates, maintains and destroys this universe.
21.translation: If Sāṅkhya is the only other, and Yoga is the other with adjectives, how can the two be one? There he argues that there is only one and the same\'Asavata, and since Sāṅkhya is the Supreme Being, since the whole universe, which is an adjective, is composed of it, it is also justified that Yoga, which is the subject of adjectives, is the Supreme Being. This is the Self, this is all, according to the scriptures. The reason here is by the self, O gentlemen! The Self-dependent, independent of others, the unborn Self, creates, maintains and destroys this universe.

22.word_for_word: किं च, विविधणीति । — What’s more, it’s diverse.; यस्यावेक्षयाऽनुग्रहेण विविधानि कर्माणि तपो-योगादीनि जनयन् कुर्वन् यद्य् अस्माद् अयं सर्वोऽपि जनो धर्मादि-लक्षणं श्रेय ईहते साधयति । — By the grace of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, all human beings are able to perform various kinds of activities such as austerities, yoga and other activities.; कर्माणि तत् फलानि च यद् अधीनानीत्य् अर्थाह् ॥२२-२३॥ — The actions and their fruits are subordinate to that, that is, 22-2
22.translation: What’s more, it’s diverse. By the grace of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, all human beings are able to perform various kinds of activities such as austerities, yoga and other activities. The actions and their fruits are subordinate to that, that is, 22-2

24.word_for_word: श्री-कृष्णानुभाव-वित् सहदेव इत्य् उक्त्वा तूष्णीम् अभूत् ॥२४-२५॥ — Sahadeva, who knew the power of Lord Kṛṣṇa, said this and became silent.
24.translation: Sahadeva, who knew the power of Lord Kṛṣṇa, said this and became silent.

26.word_for_word: द्विजेरितं साधु साध्व् इति घोषं श्रुत्वा । — Hearing the cry of the brāhmaṇas, “Well done, well done!”; हार्दम् अभिप्रायम् ॥२६-३१॥ — Heartfelt intention.26-3
26.translation: Hearing the cry of the brāhmaṇas, “Well done, well done!” Heartfelt intention.26-3

32.word_for_word: हे सदसस्पतयः! — O members of the plants!; यूयं सर्वे बालस्य भाषितं मा मन्यध्वं मा जानीत मा गृह्णीतं किं तत्तु यद्यतः कृष्णो\ऽर्हणे अग्रपूजायां सन्मतस् तत् ॥३२-३३॥ — All of you do not believe what the child says Do not know it Do not take it for granted What is that which is acceptable to Krishna in offering oblations and worshiping Him first (32-33).
32.translation: O members of the plants! All of you do not believe what the child says Do not know it Do not take it for granted What is that which is acceptable to Krishna in offering oblations and worshiping Him first (32-33).

34.word_for_word: अस्यैव वास्तवोऽर्थः पूर्ववद् उन्नेयः । — The real meaning of this is to be elevated as before.; गोपाल इति वेद-पृथिव्य्-आदि-पालक इत्य् अर्थः । — Gopala means the protector of the Vedas, the earth and other things.; कुत्सितं वेद-विपरीतं लपन्तीति कुलपाः पाखण्डास् तान् अंसते समाधातयतीति तथा सः । — He laughs at the hypocrites who blaspheme and condemns them for speaking vile things contrary to the Vedas; अकाकः कं च अकं च काके सुख-दुःखे ते न विद्येते यस्य सोऽकाकः, आप्त-काम इत्य् अर्थः । — Akaka, Kam and Akam in the crow, in happiness and sorrow, they do not exist, he is a crow, meaning that he has fulfilled his desires.; स यथा आप्त-कामो देव-योग्यं केवलं पुरोडाश-मात्रं नार्हति, अपि तु सर्वस्वम् अपि, तथायं श्री-कृष्णोऽपि ब्रह्मर्षि-योग्यं सपर्या-मात्रं कथम् अर्हति किन्त्व् आत्म-समर्पणम् अप्य् अर्हतीत्य् अर्थः ॥३४॥ — Just as a man who has fulfilled his desires deserves not only the oblations offered to the demigods but also all his possessions, so how can Lord Kṛṣṇa deserve only the offerings worthy of the brahmarṣis but also the surrender of Himself?
34.translation: The real meaning of this is to be elevated as before. Gopala means the protector of the Vedas, the earth and other things. He laughs at the hypocrites who blaspheme and condemns them for speaking vile things contrary to the Vedas Akaka, Kam and Akam in the crow, in happiness and sorrow, they do not exist, he is a crow, meaning that he has fulfilled his desires. Just as a man who has fulfilled his desires deserves not only the oblations offered to the demigods but also all his possessions, so how can Lord Kṛṣṇa deserve only the offerings worthy of the brahmarṣis but also the surrender of Himself?

35.word_for_word: वर्णाश्रम-कुलेभ्यो\ऽपेतो ब्रह्मत्वात् अनाम-गोत्रम् इति श्रुतेः । — He is detached from the varṇa and āśrama families and is a Brahmin, according to the scriptures.; अत एवानधिकारित्वात् सर्वैर् धमैर् बहिष्कृतः स्वैर-वर्ती जीवानां योग्यं तुच्छं सपर्या-मात्रं कथम् अर्हतीत्य् अर्थः ॥३५॥ — That is why, since he is excluded from all religious practices because of his lack of authority, how can a self-sufficient person deserve only the insignificant offerings worthy of living beings?
35.translation: He is detached from the varṇa and āśrama families and is a Brahmin, according to the scriptures. That is why, since he is excluded from all religious practices because of his lack of authority, how can a self-sufficient person deserve only the insignificant offerings worthy of living beings?

36.word_for_word: अपि च कथं वर्णनीयो मादृशैर् एषां यदूनां महिमा यस्माद् एषां कुलं ययातिना शप्तम् अपि किं सद्भिर् बहिष्-कृतम्, अपि तु शिरसा धृतम् । — Moreover, how can people like me describe the glory of these Yadus, for even though their dynasty was cursed by Yayāti, they were expelled by the saintly persons, but they were held on their heads.; किं चास्मद्-आदि-कुलवत् किं वृथापान-रतं अपि त्व् अतिनियताचारम् इत्य् अर्थः । — What is more, like our original family, what does it mean that even if you are indulging in vain drinking, you are behaving too regularly?; अहो यदूनाम् एव तावद् ईदृशं माहात्म्यम् । — Oh, how great is this for the Yadus!; यदु-कुल-वृद्धस्य ययातेः शापो न प्राभूद् इत्य्-आदि । — It is said that the curse of Yayāti, the elder of the Yadu dynasty, did not come upon him.; अयं तु साक्षाद् ईश्वरोऽतः सपर्या-मात्रं कथम् अर्हतीत्य् अर्थः ॥३६॥ — But this is the Lord Himself, therefore how can He deserve to be worshiped alone?
36.translation: Moreover, how can people like me describe the glory of these Yadus, for even though their dynasty was cursed by Yayāti, they were expelled by the saintly persons, but they were held on their heads. What is more, like our original family, what does it mean that even if you are indulging in vain drinking, you are behaving too regularly? Oh, how great is this for the Yadus! It is said that the curse of Yayāti, the elder of the Yadu dynasty, did not come upon him. But this is the Lord Himself, therefore how can He deserve to be worshiped alone?

37.word_for_word: किं च, ये राजानो दुष्टानुच्छाटयन्ति तद् अर्थं कीकटादि-देशान् अप्य् आश्रयन्ति । — Moreover, kings who exterminate the wicked also rely on countries such as Keekata for that purpose.; एते तु ब्रह्मर्षि-सेवितान् एव देशान् आश्रित्याब्रह्म-वर्चसं समुद्रं दुर्गम् अपि हित्वा । — These, however, took refuge in the same countries served by the Brahmarshis, leaving behind the Brahma-varsha, the sea and the fortress.; हापयित्वेत्य् अर्थः । — It means to lose.; बाधन्ते तथा या दस्यवः प्रजास् ताश् च । — They are also the thieves who obstruct the subjects.; अयम् अर्थः, वेद-तद्-अर्थाभियोगो ब्रह्म-वर्चसं तद् विरुद्धम् अब्रह्म-वर्चसं समुद्रं मुद्रात्र लिङ्गं तत्-सहितं समुद्रम् । — This means that the Vedas and their meanings are the ocean of the Brahman-varchas, the opposite of the non-Brahman-varchas, the Linga in the seal, and the ocean with it.; वेद-विरुद्ध-लिङ्ग-धारिणं पाखण्डम् इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that a hypocrite who wears a gender contrary to the Vedas.; तल्-लिङ्गं त्याजयित्वा बाधन्ते दण्डयन्ति । — They abandon the Tal-lingam and obstruct and punish them.; कथं भूतम् । — How did it happen?; दुर्गम्, धर्म-वत् प्रतीतेर् अधर्मतया दुर्ज्ञेयम् इत्य् अर्थः । — It is difficult, meaning that it is difficult to understand because of its irreligious perception as religion.; तथादस्यवो दस्यून् अपि प्रजा-वेषेण वर्तमानान् दण्डयन्ति, अतो यदुभ्योऽन्यः को नाम धार्मिकोऽस्तीति । — Similarly, the thieves punish even thieves who are disguised as subjects, so who is more righteous than the Yadus?; पारुष्यं तूक्तार्थम् एव ॥३७॥ — The harshness is for the sake of the said.
37.translation: Moreover, kings who exterminate the wicked also rely on countries such as Keekata for that purpose. These, however, took refuge in the same countries served by the Brahmarshis, leaving behind the Brahma-varsha, the sea and the fortress. It means to lose. They are also the thieves who obstruct the subjects. This means that the Vedas and their meanings are the ocean of the Brahman-varchas, the opposite of the non-Brahman-varchas, the Linga in the seal, and the ocean with it. This means that a hypocrite who wears a gender contrary to the Vedas. They abandon the Tal-lingam and obstruct and punish them. How did it happen? It is difficult, meaning that it is difficult to understand because of its irreligious perception as religion. Similarly, the thieves punish even thieves who are disguised as subjects, so who is more righteous than the Yadus? The harshness is for the sake of the said.

38.word_for_word: शिवा फेरुस् तस्या रुतं श्रुत्वा यथा सिंहो न किञ्चिद् ब्रूते तद्वत् ॥३८-४२॥ — Shiva Ferus heard her cry just as a lion does not say anything (38-42).
38.translation: Shiva Ferus heard her cry just as a lion does not say anything (38-42).

43.word_for_word: तावद् उत्थाय इत्य् अस्यायम् अभिप्रायः, एष मत्-पार्षदो मत्-तुल्य-बलः सर्वान् एतान् हन्याद् अतो मयैव शीघ्रं हन्तव्य इति तत्-क्षणम् एव उत्थाय शिरो जहार इति ॥४३-४५॥ — Then he said, "Get up, this is my companion, who is as strong as me, he will kill them all, therefore I must kill them at once," and immediately he got up and cut off his head.
43.translation: Then he said, "Get up, this is my companion, who is as strong as me, he will kill them all, therefore I must kill them at once," and immediately he got up and cut off his head.

46.word_for_word: नन्व् एवं निन्दकस्य कथं वासुदेवे प्रवेशः ? — How, then, can such a blasphemer enter Vasudeva?; तत्राह---जन्म-त्रय- इति । — There he says, the three births.; जन्म-त्रयेऽनुगुणितम् अनुवर्तितं यद् वैरं, तेन संरब्धया आविष्टया । — The enmity that followed in three lifetimes was overwhelming with anger.; तन्मयतां तत्-स्वरूपतां यातः । — He became the self-consciousness of that self.; पुनः पार्षदो बभूवेत्य् अर्थः । — This means that he became a counselor again.; अत्र हेतुः---भवो हि इति । — The reason here is that Bhavo hi.; भावो भावना अनुध्यानं भवस्य ध्येयाकार-जन्मनः कारणम् । — Bhava, feeling, and meditation are the causes of the birth of the meditative form of Bhava.; पेशस्कारि-ध्यानेन कीटादौ तथा दृष्टत्वाद् इत्य् अर्थः ॥४६-५१॥ — This means that it is seen as such in the beginning of the insect by the meditation of the peshskari.46-5
46.translation: How, then, can such a blasphemer enter Vasudeva? There he says, the three births. The enmity that followed in three lifetimes was overwhelming with anger. He became the self-consciousness of that self. This means that he became a counselor again. The reason here is that Bhavo hi. Bhava, feeling, and meditation are the causes of the birth of the meditative form of Bhava. This means that it is seen as such in the beginning of the insect by the meditation of the peshskari.46-5

52.word_for_word: सुरा मानवाः खेचराः प्रमथाश् च । — The gods, humans, astronauts and heroes.
52.translation: The gods, humans, astronauts and heroes.

53.word_for_word: पापं धर्म-द्विषम् । — Sin is the enemy of religion.; अत्र हेतुः, कलिं कलेर् अंशम् । — The reason here is that Kali is a part of Kali.; अत एव कुरु-कुलस्यामयं व्याधिवन् नाशकम् ॥५३॥ — That is why this disease of the Kuru dynasty is as destructive as disease.
53.translation: Sin is the enemy of religion. The reason here is that Kali is a part of Kali. That is why this disease of the Kuru dynasty is as destructive as disease.

54.word_for_word: वितानं यज्ञं च । — The canopy and the sacrifice.; इति श्रीमद्-भागवते महा-पुराणे दशम-स्कन्धे उत्तरार्धे श्रीधर-स्वामि-विरचितायां भावार्थ-दीपिकायाम् चतुःसप्ततितमो\ऽध्यायः ॥७४॥ — This is the seventy-fourth chapter of the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, the great Purāṇa, the tenth section, the second half of the Bhāva-artha-dīpika, compiled by Śrīdhara-svāmi.
54.translation: The canopy and the sacrifice. This is the seventy-fourth chapter of the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, the great Purāṇa, the tenth section, the second half of the Bhāva-artha-dīpika, compiled by Śrīdhara-svāmi.
